TC-01/S06.detail: N1 (admitted today, 0 prior), N3 (1 prior), N4 (2 prior), N5 (4 prior on distinct days) seeded on a fresh account; on Today's Visits and All Residents no card shows any visit number (no 'Visit N', 'Day N' or similar), so N1 < N3 < N4 < N5 cannot hold under either Q3 reading.
TC-01/S06.productIssue: A physician looking at the Nursing Home list sees no visit number on any resident card (cards show unit, age, stored diagnosis, status and admission badge only), so a resident on their 5th visit looks the same as one admitted today. Breaks UAT TC-01 Expected Result: 'the hospital day or visit number. The day/visit number advances each calendar day and must not stay frozen' (TFA-92579 AC 3/4).
